resolution.note: preflight runs review's contractDeclarations over branch commits

title: Make preflight refuse review-invalid Change-contract trailers
body:
Outcome: npm run preflight refuses the commit trailers that krn review's red-first parser (src/flow/repository.ts, Change-contract parsing) refuses: a Change-contract value that is not <test path>:red->green|green->green (including none (...) on branch commits). PR #154 passed preflight with Change-contract: none (tracker-only commit) and a bare test path, then review 2 returned INCOMPLETE and cost an operator D10 exception. One parser owner: preflight reuses the review parser instead of duplicating it.
Proof: a new observer fails at the current main by assertion on a branch with each invalid trailer and passes at head.
